verdict.rationale: The v2 API docs show EmailOctopus has its own automations that can be started for a specific contact, which points to a first-party automation feature. Nothing documents how users define event-based trigger rules or which actions those rules can run. Send-time scheduling and third-party app integrations are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented event triggers (e.g. subscribe, click, field change), a rule/condition builder, a list of available actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Start an automation for a specific contact.
